subject.title: feat(gateway): add configurable Control UI title

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new static `gateway.controlUi.title` config key, and should it take precedence over dynamic session or agent-derived browser titles?
rationale: The implementation is small and proven, but it adds a strict operator config surface and overlaps with active dynamic title work, so automation should not decide the permanent title policy.

options.title: Accept Static Title Config
options.body: Sponsor this PR direction, rebase it onto the current UI config loader, add public docs and rollback notes, and define static configured titles as the higher-precedence value.

options.title: Prefer Dynamic Titles
options.body: Pause or close the static config path and keep title behavior on the dynamic session/agent-title track instead.

options.title: Decline More Title Surface
options.body: Keep the fixed title for now if maintainers do not want another config key or title policy to support.

recommendation.title: Accept Static Title Config
recommendation.body: Sponsor this PR direction, rebase it onto the current UI config loader, add public docs and rollback notes, and define static configured titles as the higher-precedence value.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the Control UI bootstrap contract and the Gateway docs surface that would carry the decision.
